result.title: Few-Shot Adaptation of Vision-Language Models via Agentic Model Editing
result.summary: Few-shot adaptation transfers pretrained Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to new domains using a small set of labeled images. Most methods fit prompts, representations, or classifiers within an adaptation procedure specified in advance. Yet the visual distinctions needed for recognition can differ substantially across domains, motivating the question: Can an LLM agent use few-shot examples and model observations to design the adaptation procedure itself? We propose Agentic Model Editing (AME), an agentic framework that jointly designs input transformations, encoder edits, feature computation, and classifier fitting as an executable, domain-customized adaptation program. The agent inspects images, class semantics, model parameters, intermediate representations, and activations to formulate hypotheses about the target task. It implements and tests candidate programs on the support set, with aggregate validation accuracy guiding refinement and selection. Each program fits a complete domain model that is fixed before testing. The agent and its tools are shared across domains, while each domain receives its own adaptation program. Across eleven datasets with CLIP ViT-B/16, AME achieves the highest average accuracies of 81.2% without back-propagation and 81.9% with back-propagation among the compared methods. Further experiments demonstrate applicability across VLM backbones and LLM agents.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 Agentic Model Editing，用 LLM agent 依据少样本样例及模型内部观察，自动设计并验证包含输入变换、编码器编辑、特征计算与分类器拟合的领域适配程序，提升 CLIP 等 VLM 的少样本识别。
AI.relevance_reason: 其让 agent 读取中间表示与激活并生成可执行的表示或特征改写方案，可能为 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选与内部状态干预提供方法线索；但本文目标是识别适配，而非推理期 latent 生成与使用。
